description.narrative: In February 2014 increasing unrest in Ukraine resulted in violence. As this violence continues to escalate so too does the humanitarian need. Despite a truce in February 2015 violence has been on-going, with the level of violence in conflict areas in the east significantly increasing since May 2016. 3.7 Million are directly affected by the conflict and 3.1 Million vulnerable people require humanitarian assistance. More than 1.7m people are displaced and hundres of thousands more have fled the country. Furthermore areas outside of government control have experienced complete withdrawal of all government services. Inflation and food prices, physical access to markets means that coping strategies are becoming less sustainable, endangering food security and further increasing the humanitarian needs.
